scripts.build: bun run build:dev && bun run build:staging && bun run build:prod
scripts.dev:device: HOST=${API_HOST:-$(ipconfig getifaddr en0)} && flutter run --flavor dev -t lib/main_dev.dart --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://$HOST:3000 --dart-define=REALTIME_BASE_URL=ws://$HOST:3001
scripts.install:device: HOST=${API_HOST:-$(ipconfig getifaddr en0)} && flutter run --release --flavor dev -t lib/main_dev.dart --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://$HOST:3000 --dart-define=REALTIME_BASE_URL=ws://$HOST:3001
scripts.demo:device: HOST=${API_HOST:-$(ipconfig getifaddr en0)} && flutter run --release --flavor dev -t lib/main_dev.dart --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://$HOST:3000 --dart-define=REALTIME_BASE_URL=ws://$HOST:3001 --dart-define=SHOW_DEMO_LOGIN=true
scripts.check-types: echo "Skipping Flutter analyze in turbo pipeline. Run 'flutter analyze' directly in apps/mobile instead."
scripts.lint: echo "Skipping Flutter analyze in turbo pipeline. Run 'flutter analyze' directly in apps/mobile instead."
